products.title: Hy-Rib SHEET
products.heading: Hy-Rib SHEET
products.text: We are into manufacturing of hy rib used as sacrificial stoppers as replacement of conventional shuttering elements. The Product offers a number of edges over the conventional methods of pour In the Foundation Rafts. hy rib is manufactured from hot dipped galvanized steel sheets. Because of its meshes and V-patterns, it has better anti stress capability and forming flexibility than normal metal sheet.

  • Retaining Walls

  • High Rise Building Projects
  • Rafts and Foundations

products.title: METAL LINTELS
products.heading: METAL LINTELS
products.text: A lintel is a load-bearing building component over portals, doors, windows, and fireplaces. We manufacture SS/MS/GI/COATED LINTELS made of C.R. Steel sheets with perforations. These steel strips are perforated Where applicable, cut to length and then pressed to shape using special purpose machines. Tested and Certified, indeed a worthy replacement for conventional rcc lintels, speeding the construction work. Special lintels can be manufactured to suit architectural features, heavy duty applications and wall Constructions not covered by the standard range.

tabs.title: BENEFITS
tabs.html:
• Lightweight yet stronger than conventional concrete lintels thus, providing better immunity to earthquakes and tremors.
  • Easy to install into position without using lifting equipment
  • Material design better for plastering
  • High quality corrosion protection system ie. Hot dip galvanized / powder coated
  • Eliminates the need to cast concrete and saves time thus resulting in more speedy construction of walls

products.title: REBAR CONNECTION BOX
products.heading: REBAR CONNECTION BOX
products.text: Connection box is a prefabricated reinforcement bar connection system that is designed to allow simple and fast continuity of steel reinforcement across construction joints in concrete. The connection box system consists of steel reinforcement that is cut and bent accordingly to suit the project’s requirement, then factory assembled inside a special designed galvanized steel casing (box), which Is then supplied to the construction site ready for immediate installation.

tabs.title: APPLICATIONS
tabs.html:
• For use in many areas for construction joint connections:
  • Slab to wall
  • Slab to core walls
  • Slab to slab
  • Slab to diaphragm wall
  • Slab to lift core walls pre-cast concrete elements for cast-in site connections
  • Wall to wall
  • Stair flights and landings
  • Wall to column
  • Corbels

tabs.title: BENEFITS
tabs.html:
• Fast and simple to install
  • Eliminates the need of hacking concrete to expose lap reinforcement bars
  • Helps fast track concrete pouring schedules providing savings in costs and time
  • Design and installation of formwork is simplified
  • No wastage at site as the system is custom designed to suit the exact length of area
  • Cover & casing produced from pre-galvanized steel providing a strong and rigid box
  • Improves site safety as lap bars are only exposed/bent out when required
  • Provides a rebate in the concrete to give added shear resistance
  • Produced to comply to the projects anchor and lap bar configurations and to bar diameter and Spacing requirements

products.title: BLOCK WORK ACCESSORIES
products.heading: BLOCK WORK ACCESSORIES
products.text:
Wall Ties: Wall ties and restraint fixings are an essential element in the stability of masonry panels. We manufacture fixings in a variety of lengths and types for restraining brickwork, blockwork and stonework.
Corner Beads: Corner bead is a material which is used on the corners of walls to make the corners crisp and professional looking. In addition to making the corners look neater, corner bead also reinforces the corners, making them less prone to denting and other types of damage.
Plaster Mesh: As reinforcing material, plaster mesh is used for building internal and external decoration, especially in plastering work. It protects the plaster layer surface from cracking and increases the mechanical strength of the plaster layer.

tabs.title: APPLICATIONS
tabs.html:
• All Types Of Buildings, With Block Work/ Brickwork
  • Slab To Wall
  • Slab To Core Walls
  • Column To Wall

tabs.title: BENEFITS
tabs.html:
• Protection of walls against serious Earthquakes,
  • Wind Pressures
  • Prevention of developing of cracks in walls
  • Fast, Durable construction with modern techniques
